## Summary

Describe what changed and why it matters.
Use real line breaks; do not include literal `\n` sequences.

## Linked Issue

Use a closing keyword with a full URL (required):

- Closes https://github.com/shikarii/SpanPay/issues/<number>

## Base Branch

- [ ] This PR targets `develop`

## Validation

List exact commands and outcomes.

- [ ] Relevant typecheck/build/test steps listed
- [ ] Manual validation noted if applicable

## Risks and Tradeoffs

Call out behavior risks, compatibility concerns, and rollback path.

## Adversarial Review

Describe edge cases you tested and what could still fail.
